description: POST an openagents.classify.v1 envelope to the configured gateway's /v1/classify and return the report verbatim: ordered per-input results, selections, per-unit aggregates, and usage. This can consume quota or money even if no content changes.

request.description: The openagents.classify.v1 envelope: v, model, capacity, policy, inputs, and labels, levels, or dimensions.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call; retries reuse it and bump the attempt.

name: classify
title: Classify inputs through a door

description: One categorical judgment per text: the labels form one distribution and each input selects one label or the no-match outcome. Returns the full ordered report — use count_labels when only aggregates matter.

capacity.description: The capacity lane the binding declares — `shared` unless the caller's lane differs.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

labels.description: The label set: ids, or {id, description} objects the judgment reads as criteria.

min_probability.description: Abstain to the no-match outcome below this top probability.

model.description: The bound door name; absent falls back to the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call; retries reuse it and bump the attempt.

texts.description: The input texts, in the order results preserve.

uncertain_below.description: Flag the unit `uncertain` below this top probability.

name: classify_texts
title: Classify texts into one label

description: Several independent judgments over the same inputs — each dimension carries its own mode and label set or rubric. Returns the full ordered report.

capacity.description: The capacity lane the binding declares — `shared` unless the caller's lane differs.

dimensions.description: Named dimensions judged independently: single-label needs labels; multi-label and binary need labels plus a request-level threshold; score needs levels.

labels.description: The label set: ids, or {id, description} objects the judgment reads as criteria.

inputs.description: The inputs: texts, or {id, text|record} objects.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

model.description: The bound door name; absent falls back to the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call; retries reuse it and bump the attempt.

threshold.description: Required when any dimension is multi-label or binary: the probability a label must reach to be selected.

top_n.description: A cap on selected labels for multi-label dimensions.

uncertain_below.description: Flag units `uncertain` below this top probability.

name: classify_dimensions
title: Classify inputs on named dimensions

description: One independent probability per text per label — labels do not sum to one. Every label at or above the caller's threshold is selected. Returns the full ordered report.

capacity.description: The capacity lane the binding declares — `shared` unless the caller's lane differs.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

labels.description: The label set: ids, or {id, description} objects the judgment reads as criteria.

model.description: The bound door name; absent falls back to the configured default model.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call; retries reuse it and bump the attempt.

texts.description: The input texts, in the order results preserve.

threshold.description: The probability a label must reach to be selected — required; the caller's own cut, not a default.

top_n.description: A cap on selected labels per input.

uncertain_below.description: Flag the unit `uncertain` when any label's winning side is below this.

description: Runs the single-label judgment with the caller's uncertainty cut and returns the flagged items — input id, selection, and top probability — bounded by `show`, plus outcome counts. With `reviewer`, the flagged units are re-judged by that door first.

capacity.description: The capacity lane the binding declares — `shared` unless the caller's lane differs.

instructions.description: Instructions shared by every judgment in the request.

labels.description: The label set: ids, or {id, description} objects the judgment reads as criteria.

request_id.description: An idempotency key for the call; retries reuse it and bump the attempt.

reviewer.description: A bound door that re-judges the flagged units through the facade's review phase — bounds 200 items, 400 attempts, 30 s, keep-original on failure.

show.description: The most uncertain items to list; the corpus itself never enters the context.

texts.description: The input texts, in the order results preserve.
